personal.name: Umang Desai
personal.title: Senior Software Engineer
personal.summary: Senior Software Engineer with over 12 years of experience designing, developing, and deploying scalable, AI-driven systems. Currently building agentic AI services powered by LLMs, Claude SDK, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) — with expertise in autonomous planning, tool orchestration, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Deep background in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and production observability using Python, Golang, and OpenTelemetry. Hands-on, versatile engineer with an eye for simplicity and elegance.

description: Lead design and development of **Canvas Deep Agent**, Cisco's agentic AI service on the AI Studio platform — building an autonomous LLM-powered agent using **Python**, **Claude SDK**, and **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** that plans, reasons, and executes multi-step tasks with human-in-the-loop approval gates.

Pioneer **AI-driven development** practices across the engineering team, leveraging LLM-powered tooling to accelerate feature development, debugging, and architectural decision-making — maintaining structured audit trails with engineering decision records and traceable design-to-deployment workflows.

Architect distributed systems infrastructure for multi-pod **Kubernetes** deployments, implementing **Redis pub/sub** for cross-pod communication, plan approval gating mechanisms, and resilient session management that gracefully degrades under failure.

Build end-to-end **OpenTelemetry** observability for the agent lifecycle — instrumenting planning loops, tool execution chains, and LLM token utilization with granular spans and durable log export, providing full audit trails of every agent action for production debugging and performance optimization.
Drive security hardening initiatives including **Docker image hardening**, **CodeQL remediation**, sandboxed code execution with network isolation, and architectural SQL injection mitigation.

Develop Cisco's **AI Assistant for FMC and CDFMC** with **NLtoSQL** capabilities, translating natural language queries into precise SQL for firewall management, achieving a **70% latency reduction** through query optimization, caching, and indexing.

Refactor ML prototypes into production-ready backend microservices using **Python**, **Golang**, **CockroachDB**, and **AuroraDB**, with feature flags, resiliency patterns, and comprehensive error management for enterprise-grade deployment.
Designed and developed **Armorblox Data Protection** using Regex and **NLU (Natural Language Understanding)** in **Golang**, **C**, and **Python**.

Applied distributed system concepts including **RabbitMQ**, **Kafka**, and **Kubernetes** to scale the Data Protection product for high-throughput processing across **GCP** and **Azure** cloud data centers.
Designed and implemented configuration and incident management microservices using SQL data stores and **gRPC**.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams across Product Management, Customer Support, and Production Engineering for high-reliability enterprise delivery.
Improved code quality and reliability by adding comprehensive unit and integration test suites.
Maintained and re-engineered Windows development stack (**C++**, Visual Studio, WIX).
Led migration of Windows stack to modern cross-platform architecture in **Golang**.
Designed, developed, and tested a distributed, scalable container deployment system (**Docker**) for distributed workloads.
Architected platform-wide logging framework (**Fluentd**) with **ElasticSearch/S3** storage and **Grafana** visualization.
Modernized CI/CD build pipelines (**Jenkins**), improving build efficiency by **50%**.
Designed and developed telemetry services using **Prometheus** and **Grafana**.
Conducting lectures and presentations.
Grading deliverables for a full scale SDLC project, assignments, presentation peer evaluations.
Mentoring students on different stages of SDLC and conducting bi-weekly meetings for project review, enabling AGILE culture.
Introduced a culture of unit testing.
Mentoring undergraduates through office hours, teaching students of varying levels of understanding the concepts of Java Object Oriented Programming.
Conducting lectures and programming labs.
Grading assignments, labs, projects.
Social event discovery application to correlate user and events geospatial data and indicate suitable local events for a user.
Designing and developing backend, databases and data-models.
Maintain, monitor and review development of the application and manage project deadlines.
Actively involved in software architecture and product development.
Designed, developed and tested module to monitor JVM on a host by extracting telemetry data using JAVA, MSSQL and JMX. This was achieved via a 3 tier client-server-data backend architecture.
Designed and modeled a database for the data extracted. Then developed advanced filtering across multiple Mbeans for retrieving these metrics for bandwidth friendly data pipelines.
Configured frameworks like XStream for configuration files and models, log4j for logging.
Designed, developed and tested module to monitor Linux via the proc fs to analyze system performance and uptime. This was achieved with JAVA and MSSQL
Developed a parsing framework for system proc files with configurable polling mechanisms.
